note: Beaver County, OK: Oklahoma counties have limited zoning authority; the county publishes no zoning districts layer. The Town of Beaver (county seat) adopts a zoning ordinance by reference (amlegal), but no official zoning district map or ArcGIS/WFS service was found in searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online, county and town sites, or gismaps.org. Forgan, Gate, Elmwood have no zoning GIS found either. Only parcel data (paid portal) and a state CLO web map (state land) exist.
